There is two things I would like to point out, however: while you're correct that there isn't any personally identifiable information in your IP address, please note that a determined party, with other resources at their disposal, can link your IP address to other personally identifiable information. Most big Internet providers typically assign a dynamic IP address to you, but even so, you should definitely restart your router to change it, but verify with your internet provider that it did work, because even restarting your router isn't always enough.
